subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Switch On – Technology helps everyone (video and project)
outcomes: Explain how technology helps people stay healthy.
Use words like telemedicine, wearable devices and 3D printing.
Design and present a new technology for a health problem.

tf.s: Telemedicine lets people talk to doctors without travelling to a hospital.
tf.why: Yes, by video call or online.

tf.s: A cochlear implant changes sounds into electronic signals.
tf.why: That is how it helps people hear.

tf.s: In the project, each group writes a short description of its technology.
tf.why: Yes, the group describes its new technology.

tf.s: AI can write medical notes for doctors.
tf.why: Yes, so doctors spend less time on paperwork.

tf.s: Smartwatches and smart rings are examples of wearable devices.
tf.why: We wear them on our body.

tf.s: Wearable devices can only tell the time.
tf.why: They can also track things like sleep.

tf.s: In the project vote, students can vote for their own group.
tf.why: Students vote for another group's design.

tf.s: The project starts by finding out about health technologies that already exist.
Each group gives only one reason why its technology is useful.
3D printing makes prosthetics slower to produce.
tf.why: 3D-printed prosthetics are quicker and cheaper to make.

boxes.q: Who reports the group's choice to the class?
boxes.why: The chairperson reports for the group.
Patients talk to doctors by video call.
You wear a smart ring on your finger.

boxes.q: What does the group sketch in step 2?
boxes.why: Groups plan what their new technology will look like.

boxes.q: Which project role speaks to the class?
What do drones carry to hard-to-reach places?
boxes.why: Drones can carry medicine and vaccines.

boxes.q: Which problem could a new health device solve?
boxes.why: A reminder device can help people take medicine.

boxes.q: What does a digital tooth scanner help with?

mcq.q: What is the video mainly about?
o: How technology helps people stay healthy
mcq.why: The video shows technology that helps health.

mcq.q: In step 1, what should you find out about existing technologies?
o: What services they provide and how they help
mcq.why: Research what they do, how they help and how to improve them.

mcq.q: In the project, what does the question handler do?
mcq.why: The question handler answers questions after the presentation.

mcq.q: Which word means 'artificial arms or legs'?
A family lives far from any hospital. Their child has a cough. Which technology can help first?
mcq.why: They can talk to a doctor online without travelling.

mcq.q: Complete: Our device ___ people who live far from hospitals.
mcq.why: 'Will help' talks about what the device is going to do.

mcq.q: Your grandfather often forgets his medicine. Which new idea solves this problem?
o: A smart bracelet that reminds him
A drone that films the garden
mcq.why: A reminder device matches the problem.

mcq.q: A girl could not hear well. Now she can hear sounds. Which technology probably helped her?
mcq.why: A cochlear implant helps people hear.

mcq.q: Which is the best reason to choose drones as the most helpful technology?
o: They reach places that are hard to get to.
mcq.why: A good reason explains how it helps people's health.

mcq.q: A group says: 'Our robot nurse can help many patients at night.' What is this?
o: A reason the technology is useful
mcq.why: It explains why their design is helpful.
